name: io.github.orldev/snail-mcp-playwright
description: Searches the web and reads pages through a real browser: text, site walks, screenshots and forms.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_PLAYWRIGHT_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port to answer sessions on at /mcp; unset means the server is started as a program and speaks stdio to its parent.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_PLAYWRIGHT_ENGINES
environmentVariables.description: Search engines to ask, comma-separated: DuckDuckGo, Bing, Brave, Google. Google answers by address rather than by query and is off by default.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSER_PROBE_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Seconds playwright_diagnose waits for the browser before calling it unreachable, 1 to 120.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_PLAYWRIGHT_SEARCH_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Seconds one search may take, 5 to 300; an engine that does not open inside them is not asked and says so.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_PLAYWRIGHT_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ADDRESSES
environmentVariables.description: Whether addresses inside the deployment's own network may be read; a developer's switch.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_PLAYWRIGHT_PAGE_MEMORY_MINUTES
environmentVariables.description: Minutes a page that was read is remembered, so the rest of it is served without a second visit, 0 to 120; 0 forgets at once.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_PLAYWRIGHT_PAGE_MEMORY_PAGES
environmentVariables.description: Pages remembered at once, 1 to 256.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_PLAYWRIGHT_PAGE_MEMORY_MEGABYTES
environmentVariables.description: Megabytes of markup and text the remembered pages may hold together, 1 to 1024; the oldest give way first, and the page read last is kept whatever its size.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_PLAYWRIGHT_WEB__SCRAPING__BROWSER_SERVER
environmentVariables.description: The ws:// address of the Playwright browser server, the ghcr.io/orldev/ff-juggler container.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_PLAYWRIGHT_WEB__SCRAPING__ENGINE
environmentVariables.description: The engine of the browser behind the server: Firefox for the ff-juggler image. It has to agree with the user agent.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_PLAYWRIGHT_WEB__SCRAPING__NAVIGATION_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Milliseconds one page may take to load.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_PLAYWRIGHT_WEB__IDENTITY__FINGERPRINTS__0__USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: The user agent the server announces; it has to name the browser in the image, or the server refuses to start.
environmentVariables.default: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64; rv:153.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/153.0

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_PLAYWRIGHT_WEB__IDENTITY__FINGERPRINTS__0__LOCALE
environmentVariables.description: The locale a page reads; moves together with the timezone and the accepted languages.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_PLAYWRIGHT_WEB__IDENTITY__FINGERPRINTS__0__TIMEZONE
environmentVariables.description: The timezone a page reads, which equals the image's own.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_PLAYWRIGHT_WEB__IDENTITY__FINGERPRINTS__0__ACCEPT_LANGUAGE
environmentVariables.description: The languages the server asks pages in.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_PLAYWRIGHT_WEB__IDENTITY__PROXIES__0
environmentVariables.description: An exit to go out through, for the browser and the HTTP engine alike; add PROXIES__1 and so on for more.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_PLAYWRIGHT_WEB__POLITENESS__MIN_DELAY_PER_HOST
environmentVariables.description: The gap left between two requests to one host, as hh:mm:ss.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_PLAYWRIGHT_WEB__ROBOTS__IS_OBEYED
environmentVariables.description: Whether robots.txt is obeyed when a page is read.
